description.value: Cora's is a franchise location of the well-known Canadian breakfast and lunch chain celebrated for its elaborate fresh fruit platters, crêpes, and egg-based dishes. Situated on the Princeton-Kamloops Highway, this full-service restaurant offers a dining room, outdoor patio, takeout, and delivery. It provides a reliable and filling meal stop for touring cyclists passing through Kamloops.

address.value: 1801 Princeton-Kamloops Highway, Unit 601-602, Kamloops, BC V2E2J7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Cora Kamloops franchise page confirms an active location at 1801 Princeton-Kamloops Highway, Unit 601-602, Kamloops, BC V2E2J7 with phone (778) 471-5944, both matching OSM. The website explicitly lists services as Dining room, Delivery, Take-out, Meeting room, and Patio; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi appears in the website content, so those are null despite OSM carrying internet_access=yes. OSM opening_hours lists a close time of 04:00 which contradicts the website's 15:00 close and appears to be a data entry error.
concerns: OSM name is 'Cora's' (possessive apostrophe) but the brand name on the website is 'Cora' or 'Cora Breakfast and Lunch' — no possessive form used.
OSM opening_hours tag lists a close time of 04:00, which appears to be a data entry error; the website shows daily close at 15:00.
OSM carries internet_access=yes but the website makes no mention of Wi-Fi; amenity left as null per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, confirmed franchise restaurant with takeout that could serve as a meal stop, but no bike parking or other cyclist-specific amenities are confirmed; reviewer should assess whether a chain breakfast restaurant with no documented cycling amenities meets the bar for the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website lists a patio as one of the services, which could potentially support bike visibility; no explicit mention of bike parking adjacent to the patio was found in the website content.
